title: Number of People Aware of a Secret
summary: On the first day, one individual learns a secret.
statement: On the first day, one individual learns a secret. Each person starts sharing the secret after a specified delay period and stops sharing after a certain number of days. Calculate the total number of individuals aware of the secret by the end of day n, considering the secret's sharing and forgetting rules, and provide the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: One person learns the secret on day one.
A person starts sharing delay days after learning and shares once per day until strictly before the day they forget.
Return how many people still remember at the end of day n, modulo 1,000,000,007.
reference_solution:
def people_aware_of_secret(n,delay,forget):
    learned=[0]*(n+1);learned[1]=1;sharing=0
    for day in range(2,n+1):
        if day-delay>=1:sharing+=learned[day-delay]
        if day-forget>=1:sharing-=learned[day-forget]
        learned[day]=sharing%1000000007
    return sum(learned[max(1,n-forget+1):])%1000000007

Today’s learner count equals that sharing count; at the end sum learners from the last forget-1 days.
The window boundaries encode exactly each cohort’s sharing and remembering interval, so every person is counted on precisely the valid days.
